description: Close an open position (fully, or partially with `volume`) or cancel a pending order on the user's live MT5 account, by ticket. REAL MONEY: only call this after the user explicitly approved closing/cancelling the exact ticket. The tool auto-detects position vs pending order from the latest snapshot (CLOSE_POSITION / PARTIAL_CLOSE / CANCEL_ORDER). Confirm the result with get_my_mt5_account. Requires a personal SocialForex API token. Create one at /mt5 (section "Connect an AI assistant (MCP)") and add it to the MCP client as header `Authorization: Bearer sfmcp_...`.

ticket.description: Ticket of the position or pending order (from get_my_mt5_account)

volume.description: Lots to close for a partial close; omit to close the whole position. Ignored for pending orders.

name: close_mt5_order
title: Close MT5 position / cancel pending order
